props.gloss_en: Rav Ashi to Ravina: [the double liability is] in one who says: wherever it wishes, let it rest
it is obvious: one who intended to throw eight [cubits] and threw four [is liable]
it is as one who wrote שם out of שמעון
one who intended to throw four and threw eight: this is Ravina's question to Rav Ashi, and he answered -- [liable] in one who says: wherever it wishes, let it rest

objections.gloss_en: ודקאמרת הרי כתב שם משמעון, מי דמי? התם כמה דלא כתיב שם לא מכתיב ליה שמעון, הכא כמה דלא זריק ארבע לא מיזדרקי ליה תמני?! -- writing שמעון must pass through שם, but a throw of eight need not pass through a landing at four; no answer is given
